result.instructions: Tools for Tapfiliate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which affiliates earned the most commission this month?"; "List the conversions from the last 7 days that are still pending."; "Show the open balance of affiliate 12345 in each currency.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tapfiliate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tapfiliate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tapfiliate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tapfiliate_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tapfiliate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_programs
tools.title: List programs
tools.description: List the affiliate programs in the account (id, title, currency, cookie time, recurring, status). Good first call. GET /programs/.

asset_id.description: Only programs for this asset id.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_program
tools.title: Get program
tools.description: Get one affiliate program with its settings and commission types. GET /programs/{program_id}/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_program_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates in a program
tools.description: List the affiliates enrolled in one program, with approval state and referral link. GET /programs/{program_id}/affiliates/.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates
tools.description: List affiliates across the account, filtered by click, email, referral code, parent or group. GET /affiliates/.

click_id.description: Filter by the click that brought the affiliate.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_affiliate
tools.title: Get affiliate
tools.description: Get one affiliate with contact details, group, parent and custom fields. GET /affiliates/{affiliate_id}/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_affiliate_balances
tools.title: Get affiliate balances
tools.description: Get one affiliate's open balance per currency, for example {USD, EUR}. GET /affiliates/{affiliate_id}/balances/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_affiliate_payments
tools.title: List affiliate payments
tools.description: List the payments made to one affiliate. GET /affiliates/{affiliate_id}/payments/.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_affiliate_groups
tools.title: List affiliate groups
tools.description: List the affiliate groups (id, title, affiliate count). GET /affiliate-groups/.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_conversions
tools.title: List conversions
tools.description: List conversions (sales or sign-ups credited to affiliates), filtered by program, affiliate, external id, pending state and dates. GET /conversions/.

external_id.description: Filter by your own order or sale id.

date_from.description: Date filter, for example 2026-01-01 or a date-time.

date_to.description: Date filter, for example 2026-01-01 or a date-time.

use_profile_timezone.description: Apply the account timezone to the dates.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_conversion
tools.title: Get conversion
tools.description: Get one conversion with its commissions, affiliate, customer and program. GET /conversions/{conversion_id}/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_commissions
tools.title: List commissions
tools.description: List commissions by affiliate, approval status or paid state. The API gives no guaranteed order, so a full walk can miss or repeat items. GET /commissions/.

status.description: Filter by commission status as the API defines it.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_commission
tools.title: Get commission
tools.description: Get one commission with amount, type, approval state and payout. GET /commissions/{commission_id}/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List referred customers, filtered by program, customer id, affiliate and dates. GET /customers/.

date_from.description: Date filter, for example 2026-01-01 or a date-time.

date_to.description: Date filter, for example 2026-01-01 or a date-time.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one referred customer with status, affiliate and program. GET /customers/{id}/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_clicks
tools.title: List clicks
tools.description: List tracked link clicks, filtered by program, affiliate and dates. Limit 900 per minute per key. GET /clicks/.

date_from.description: Date filter, for example 2026-01-01 or a date-time.

date_to.description: Date filter, for example 2026-01-01 or a date-time.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_get_click
tools.title: Get click details
tools.description: Get one click with device, country, affiliate, program and link. Needs the click-report feature on the account plan (otherwise 403). A click created through the API appears only after background processing. GET /clicks/{id}/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_list_balances
tools.title: List balances
tools.description: List the open balance of every affiliate. Limit 10 per minute per key. GET /balances/.

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.title: List payments

page.description: Page number, starts at 1. Lists return 25 items per page.

tools.name: tapfiliate_create_affiliate
tools.title: Create affiliate
tools.description: Create an affiliate in the account. Creates a new partner record: check for an existing email first. POST /affiliates/.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name.

tools.name: tapfiliate_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Record a referred customer (a trial, lead or new customer) against an affiliate. Creates a record: avoid duplicates. POST /customers/.

click_id.description: Click id from the tracking link.

coupon.description: Coupon code that credits an affiliate.

asset_id.description: Asset id of the tracked link.

source_id.description: Source id of the tracked link.

tools.name: tapfiliate_create_conversion
tools.title: Create conversion
tools.description: Record a sale (conversion) credited to an affiliate, which creates commissions. Creates money-related records: check for an existing external_id first. POST /conversions/.

external_id.description: Your order or sale id. Use it to avoid duplicates.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example EUR.

click_id.description: Click id from the tracking link.

coupon.description: Coupon code that credits an affiliate.

asset_id.description: Asset id of the tracked link.

source_id.description: Source id of the tracked link.

commission_type.description: Commission type name for this sale.

program_group.description: Program group name, when the account uses groups.

tools.name: tapfiliate_set_affiliate_group
tools.title: Set affiliate group
tools.description: Move one affiliate into an affiliate group. Replaces the current group. PUT /affiliates/{affiliate_id}/group/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_approve_commission
tools.title: Approve commission
tools.description: Mark one commission as approved, so it can be paid. PUT /commissions/{commission_id}/approved/.

tools.name: tapfiliate_disapprove_commission
tools.title: Disapprove commission
tools.description: Remove the approval from one commission, so it is not paid. Can stop a pending payout. DELETE /commissions/{commission_id}/approved/.
